infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The inspector app uses the camera to photograph packaged commodity labels for compliance analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allows you to attach an existing label photograph to an inspection.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow the inspector app to use the camera to capture label photographs.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow the inspector app to attach existing label photographs to an inspection.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow the inspector app to record where an inspection was carried out.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow the inspector app to record where an inspection was carried out.
